subject: Digital Electronics
questionText:
If we want to decrease the resolution of DAC then
(a)
we need to increase the reference voltage.
(b) we need to decrease the number of bits.
(c)
we need to increase the number of bits.
(d) none of these.

options.text: we need to increase the reference voltage.
we need to decrease the number of bits.
we need to increase the number of bits.

explanation: Practice Question from Digital Electronics DPP-13 (Digital Electronics Practice Sheet 13).
